weight_management_program.text:
A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 32.6 — long discussion about weight management options: structured weight-loss program through the clinic, dietitian referral, meal replacement approach, and an exercise prescription. Patient declined enrollment in the structured weight management program and declined the dietitian referral at this time; prefers to manage on her own. Referral placed anyway in case she changes her mind.
2. GERD — stable on omeprazole.
3. Low back pain — stable.

GASTROENTEROLOGY PROCEDURE NOTE — 01/31/2026
Screening colonoscopy.
Prep: clear liquid diet the day before, split-dose; good prep.
Findings: two small (3 mm) polyps in sigmoid colon removed. Otherwise normal.
Plan: resume regular diet; pathology pending.

TELEPHONE ENCOUNTER — 03/17/2026
Nutrition referral closed — patient did not schedule after 3 outreach attempts. Not enrolled in the weight management program. PCP notified.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 05/11/2026
S: Follow-up reflux and weight. Weight management reviewed: no formal diet or exercise regimen at this time. Did not schedule with nutrition.
O: Wt 87.3 kg, BMI 32.9. BP 112/79.
A/P:
1. Obesity — options reviewed again; she will consider.
2. GERD — stable.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/08/2026
S: 49 y/o F, follow-up weight. Weight 87.1 kg, unchanged since December. Weight-loss goals discussed again; still no structured diet or exercise program. Would like to try medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis, no gallbladder disease.
O: Wt 87.1 kg, BMI 32.8. BP 126/77.
